783.title: Trouble in the Vale
783.details:
Another one come to the priory, is it? Good. We need every pair of hands we can get.

The vale isn't what it was. Burrowlings have come up out of the old mine, masked men have made camp across the stream, and the wolves have grown bold enough to take sheep from the lower fields.

Prior Anselm keeps the priory's business. You'll find him before the chapel. Tell him I sent you.
783.objectives: Speak with Prior Anselm in front of the chapel.
783.completion:
The warden sent you? Then you are welcome here, and you have come at a hard time.

We are a house of prayer, not a garrison, yet the vale looks to us for its safety. Rest a moment, and then let us talk about what must be done.

7.title: Pests in the Lower Fields
7.details:
The burrowlings are small creatures, and on their own they are more nuisance than threat. But the runts have taken to the road west of the priory, the one that leads to the old mine, and our carters will not use it.

Thin their numbers. Ten of the runts should be enough to make the rest think twice.
7.objectives: Kill 10 Burrowling Runts on the mine road, then return to Prior Anselm.
7.progress: The carters still won't take the mine road. Have you dealt with the runts?
7.completion:
Good work. The road should be quieter now, for a little while at least.

Take this for your trouble. The priory pays what it can.

15.title: Diggers on the Ridge
15.details:
The runts were only the edge of it. Our woodcutters say there are burrowlings digging in the open around the mine entrance now, turning up the ground as if they are looking for something.

I would know what draws them out of the dark. Go to the mine, and drive off the diggers. Ten of them.
15.objectives: Kill 10 Burrowling Diggers at the mine, then return to Prior Anselm.
15.progress: Have the diggers been driven off?
15.completion:
So many of them, and digging in daylight. They are not wandering. They are being sent.

You have done the priory a service. Here.

21.title: The Mine Mouth
21.details:
Whatever drives the burrowlings out, it is the haulers who carry the work. They drag ore and spoil out of the mine and pile it in the open, and every day the piles grow.

Break their labor. Kill twelve of the haulers around the mine mouth, and perhaps the others will lose their nerve. Come back to me when it is done, and the priory's stores will see you properly outfitted.
21.objectives: Kill 12 Burrowling Haulers around the mine, then return to Prior Anselm.
21.progress: Are the haulers still working the mine mouth?
21.completion:
Then the mine is quiet, for now. You have done more for this vale in a few days than our prayers did in a season.

Take your pick from the stores. You have earned it.

5261.title: The Huntsman
5261.details:
Wat Cobbe keeps the priory in meat and hides. He's camped outside the south gate, by the road.

He was asking after anyone handy with a blade. Go and see what he wants.
5261.objectives: Speak with Wat Cobbe outside the south gate.
5261.completion: The warden sent you? Good. I could use another hunter, and I can't be everywhere at once.

33.title: Meat for the Larder
33.details:
The wolves in the meadows south of here have grown fat on the priory's sheep. Fair's fair: we'll eat them instead.

Bring me eight cuts of tough wolf meat. It isn't fine eating, but salted and stewed it will see the brothers through the winter. Not every wolf will have meat worth taking, so mind you look.
33.objectives: Bring 8 Tough Wolf Meat to Wat Cobbe.
33.progress: Got that meat for me? The salt barrels are waiting.
33.completion: That will fill a barrel or two. Here, I've some hides I've worked. Take whichever suits you.

18.title: The Masked Men
18.details:
There's a band of brigands camped across the stream, to the southeast, where the road bends. They wear red masks so no one will know their faces, and they've robbed every traveller on the road this month.

I can't leave the gate, but you can. Bring me twelve of those masks. I want them to know someone is coming for them.
18.objectives: Bring 12 Red Sackcloth Masks to Warden Hale.
18.progress: No masks yet? Their camp is across the stream, southeast, where the road bends.
18.completion:
Twelve masks. They'll be talking about that around their fire tonight.

The priory armory can spare a weapon for someone who's earned it. Choose one.

60.title: Wax for the Chapel
60.details:
Our chapel has burned the same candles since the burrowlings took the mine, and we have none left to make more. But the little thieves carry candles of their own down in the dark. Good wax, stolen from our stores more than likely.

The delvers by the mine entrance carry them. Bring me eight, and I'll see you rewarded.
60.objectives: Bring 8 Large Candles to Friar Osric.
60.progress: The chapel is dim without its candles. Any luck at the mine?
60.completion:
Bless you. The brothers will have light for vespers again.

Take these tapers, and a few coins. A light in the dark is worth having.

47.title: Dust in the Seams
47.details:
Something you might not know: that old mine never gave much iron, but there was gold in the seams, a little. The delvers have been scraping it out for months.

Gold dust is useful to a smith. Fluxes, gilding, and the like. Bring me ten pinches from the delvers and I'll pay you for your trouble.
47.objectives: Bring 10 Gold Dust to Hugh Stannard.
47.progress: Any gold dust? The delvers carry it about in little pouches.
47.completion: That's fine dust, that is. Here, your coin, and a little something I took off a traveller who couldn't pay for his repairs.

2158.title: A Night at the Harrow
2158.details:
You've done the priory a great deal of good, and I'd not keep you here longer than the vale needs you.

South over the mountains, through the pass past the bridge, lies Harrowfield and the village of Wexford. The Harrow Inn there keeps a warm hearth and a soft bed. Hilde Barrow runs it, and she owes this house a kindness or two.

Go and rest there a while. Tell her I sent you.
2158.objectives: Speak with Hilde Barrow at the Harrow Inn in Wexford, south through the pass.
2158.completion: Prior Anselm sent you? Then you're welcome twice over. Sit, warm yourself, and take something for the road. A full belly makes the miles shorter.

40.title: Word for the Marshal
40.details:
A rider came up from Harrowfield with bad news. The marshal at Wexford has his hands full: gnolls in the southern hills, fish-men fouling the mere, brigands squatting in a burned farmstead. Sounds like our troubles, only more of them.

You've proved yourself here. Go south through the pass and offer Marshal Edric Thorne your sword. He'll be on the green in Wexford.
40.objectives: Report to Marshal Edric Thorne in Wexford.
40.completion:
The warden sent you? Good man, Hale. He knows I'd not ask for help unless I needed it.

And I need it. Look around you. Harrowfield is good land, and it's being picked to the bone.

11.title: Ditchjaw Bounty
11.details:
The Ditchjaw gnolls have come down out of the southern hills, bold as you please. They've raided the outlying farms twice this month and killed a shepherd at the ford.

The marshal has put a bounty on them. The runts and outriders wear painted armbands; bring me eight of them and I'll see you're paid from the watch's purse.
11.objectives: Bring 8 Painted Ditchjaw Armbands to Deputy Nell Garrow at the south watch.
11.progress: Any luck in the hills? The gnolls aren't getting fewer on their own.
11.completion: Eight armbands. That's eight fewer gnolls raiding our farms. Here, take your pick. You've earned it.

46.title: Fins for the Watch
46.details:
The fish-men are spreading down the stream from the mere. Mirefins, the fishermen call them. The lurkers and foragers below the mere are the worst, bigger and meaner than the ones on the shore, and they've started taking nets and traps.

The watch pays for every torn fin brought in. Eight of them should prove you've thinned them out.
46.objectives: Bring 8 Torn Mirefin Fins to Watchman Colm Ashby by the Mirrow Mere.
46.progress: The stream won't clear itself. How many fins have you got?
46.completion: That'll keep them off the fords for a while. Choose something from the watch's stores. Good steel, most of it.

52.title: Thinning the Woods
52.details:
Something's driven the beasts out of the deep woods to the southeast. Prowlers and young bears have been coming right up to the mere, and a woodcutter was mauled last week.

I can't leave my post. Go into the southeast woods and kill 8 prowlers and 5 young forest bears. That should push the rest back where they belong.
52.objectives: Kill 8 Prowlers and 5 Young Forest Bears in the southeast woods, then return to Watchman Colm Ashby.
52.progress: Still hearing the prowlers at night. Keep at it.
52.completion: Quieter out there already. You've done the woodcutters a kindness. Take these, and a little coin for your trouble.

83.title: Red Kerchiefs
83.details:
Those brigands holed up in the old Ashe farmstead to the southwest wear red linen kerchiefs over their faces. Good linen, mind you, and I'd wager it was stolen from my own shop.

Bring me back six of those kerchiefs and I'll turn them into something more honest. I'll make you something for your trouble.
83.objectives: Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to Wenna Lisle in Wexford.
83.progress: Have you got my linen back from those thieves?
83.completion: My own weave, I'd know it anywhere. Thank you. Here, I made these up while you were away. They should fit you well enough.

88.title: The Old Duchess
88.details:
You see that sow out in the pumpkin patch? That's the Old Duchess. She's been eating our harvest all autumn, and she and her litter have trampled what they haven't eaten.

She's too big and too mean for my husband to handle, and she bit the dog. She wears a brass collar from when she won a prize at the fair, years back. Put an end to her and bring me the collar, so I know it's done.
88.objectives: Bring the Brass Collar from the Old Duchess to Goodwife Joan Coombe at the Coombe farm.
88.progress: Is that old sow still in my pumpkins?
88.completion: That's her collar, right enough. First prize at the Wexford fair, she was. Well, she's had her last pumpkin. Thank you, truly. Take one of these.

85.title: The Lost Necklace
85.details:
Oh, I've lost my necklace! My mother's, it was, and I wore it every day. I think I lost it walking past the Old Delve, before the burrowlings moved in there.

The Wainwright boy, Hob, was out that way the same day. He's always poking around where he shouldn't. Would you ask him if he saw anything? He's at his family's cottage on the road to the mere.
85.objectives: Speak with Hob Wainwright at the cottage on the road to the Mirrow Mere.
85.completion: Aunt Bess's necklace? Maybe I saw it, and maybe I didn't. I'm awful hungry, though. A body can't remember things on an empty stomach.

86.title: Pie for Hob
86.details:
Aunt Bess makes the best pork belly pie in Harrowfield, and she never makes it for me. If she made me a pie, I'd remember all sorts of things.

She'll need meat for it, though. The flintback boars in the west meadow are good eating. Bring her four chunks of boar meat and ask her to make me a pie.
86.objectives: Bring 4 Chunks of Boar Meat to Aunt Bess Coombe at the Coombe farm.
86.progress: Did Hob send you for boar meat? That boy and his stomach.
86.completion: Four good chunks. Well, if pie is what it takes to loosen his tongue, pie he shall have. It'll be done in no time.

84.title: Back to Hob
84.details: Here's the pie, still warm. Take it to Hob, and make sure he tells you what he knows about my necklace before he eats it all.
84.objectives: Bring the Pork Belly Pie to Hob Wainwright.
84.completion: Ooh, pork belly pie! All right, all right. I saw a burrowling with something shiny round its neck, by the Old Delve. A big one with a brass tooth. The others call him Brasstooth.

87.title: Brasstooth
87.details:
The burrowling with the brass tooth had Aunt Bess's necklace, I'm sure of it. He's down at the Old Delve, in the northwest hills. He's the biggest one there, deep by the mine mouth.

I'd get it myself, but they've got spiders down there. Big ones.
87.objectives: Bring Bess's Necklace to Aunt Bess Coombe at the Coombe farm.
87.progress: Did you find my necklace, dear?
87.completion: My mother's necklace! I never thought I'd see it again. You are a treasure. Here, these gloves were my husband's. He'd want someone brave to have them.

106.title: Young Hearts
106.details:
Can you keep a secret? Tam Coombe and I are... well, we're sweet on each other. But his family and mine haven't spoken since the quarrel over the boundary stones, and my father would lock me in the cellar if he knew.

Would you take this letter to Tam? He works on the Coombe farm, west of Wexford. Please don't let anyone else see it.
106.objectives: Take Elsie's Love Letter to Tam Coombe at the Coombe farm.
106.progress: Have you seen Elsie? Is she all right?
106.completion: A letter from Elsie? Thank you, friend. She says... she says she wants to leave Harrowfield with me. I'd go tonight if I could.

111.title: Speak with Granny
111.details:
If Elsie and I are going to run off together, we'll need help. Granny is the only one in my family who'll listen. She was young once too, she always says.

Would you speak to her for me? She's by the farmhouse. Tell her about Elsie and me.
111.objectives: Speak with Granny Coombe at the Coombe farm.
111.completion:
Tam and the Wainwright girl? Ha! I knew it. I've seen the way he looks toward that cottage.

Well, I'm not one to stand in the way of young hearts. I have an idea.

107.title: A Note for the Herbalist
107.details:
Alder Quill, the herbalist in Wexford, owes me a favor from long ago. He knows how to brew a draught that hides a body from sight. With it, Elsie could slip out of her father's house and no one the wiser.

Take him this note. He'll know what to do.
107.objectives: Take Granny Coombe's Note to Alder Quill in Wexford.
107.completion:
From Granny Coombe? It has been a long time. Hmm. She wants a draught of hiding, for a pair of young lovers. That woman never changes.

Very well. But I'll need something for it.

112.title: Kelp from the Mere
112.details:
The draught needs crystal kelp, which grows only in the Mirrow Mere. The mirefins gather it and carry it about with them, the odd creatures. I'm too old to go wading after them.

Bring me four crystal kelp fronds from the mirefins on the mere's shores and I'll brew the draught.
112.objectives: Bring 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds to Alder Quill in Wexford.
112.completion: That's the stuff. Give me a moment. A pinch of this, a drop of that, and a little patience.

114.title: The Escape
114.details:
It's ready. Take this draught to Elsie Wainwright. She's to drink it the night she and young Tam mean to leave. It will hide her long enough to get clear of the village.

And tell her to be careful. The roads aren't safe these days.
114.objectives: Take the Invisibility Liquor to Elsie Wainwright at the cottage on the road to the Mirrow Mere.
114.progress: Do you have something for me?
114.completion: From Alder Quill? Oh, thank you! Tam and I will be gone by the next new moon. I'll never forget what you've done for us. Here, take these. You'll need them more than I will.

176.title: Wanted: Grunmaw
176.details:
There's a gnoll the Ditchjaws follow, a great brute called Grunmaw. He's bigger than any gnoll I've seen and twice as savage. Three of my watchmen have gone up against him and none came back.

He holds a camp in the southern hills, west of the gnoll runs. Bring me his claw and the bounty is yours. And don't go alone. Grunmaw has killed better fighters than either of us.
176.objectives: Bring Grunmaw's Claw to Marshal Edric Thorne in Wexford.
176.progress: Grunmaw is still out there, then.
176.completion: His claw. I'd not have believed it if I weren't holding it. You've done Harrowfield a great service. Take your pick from the armory, with my thanks.

62.title: The Old Delve
62.details:
The burrowlings came up out of the Old Delve, the old mine in the northwest hills, and they've not stopped coming. Before I send anyone in after them, I need to know what we're facing.

Go up the road past the Coombe farm to the mine and have a look round. How many there are, how deep they've dug. Don't get yourself killed doing it.
62.objectives: Explore the Old Delve, then return to Marshal Edric Thorne in Wexford.
62.completion:
That many? And firecallers among them. I feared as much.

You've a sharp eye. Take this for your trouble.

76.title: Copperhollow
76.details:
There's a second mine, Copperhollow, in the hills northeast of here, off the pass road's branch east. The miners walked out of it a year ago and nobody's been back since.

If the burrowlings have taken that one too, we're in worse shape than I thought. Go and see.
76.objectives: Explore Copperhollow, then report back to Marshal Edric Thorne in Wexford.
76.completion:
Both mines, then. They're spreading through the hills like rot through a fence post.

Well, now I know. That's worth something.

239.title: The South Watch Needs Help!
239.details:
A runner came up from the south watch this morning. Deputy Garrow holds the bridge over the stream with a handful of watchmen, and the Ditchjaw gnolls have been testing her post every night.

She needs another sword more than I do. Follow the south road down to the bridge and report to her.
239.objectives: Go to the south watch by the stream bridge and speak with Deputy Nell Garrow.
239.completion:
The marshal sent you? Thank the light. We've been holding this bridge on cold suppers and no sleep.

If you're staying, there's work for you.

35.title: Further Concerns
35.details:
The fish-men at the mere worry me more than they should. Watchman Ashby keeps an eye on them from his hut on the mere's west shore, and his last report was short and strange.

Go and speak with him. Find out what he isn't putting in writing.
35.objectives: Speak with Watchman Colm Ashby at his hut on the west shore of the Mirrow Mere.
35.completion: The marshal wants to know what's wrong? I'll tell you what's wrong. Two of my watchmen are missing.

37.title: Find the Lost Watchmen
37.details:
Aldous and Merrick went round the north shore of the mere three days ago to count the fish-men's huts on the east shore. They should have been back by nightfall.

I can't leave the hut. Follow the shore road north and east and look for them. If they're hurt, help them. If they're not... find out what happened.
37.objectives: Search the north shore of the Mirrow Mere for the lost watchmen, Aldous and Merrick.
37.completion:
A body lies half in the reeds, torn and chewed. What's left of the tabard is Wexford Watch blue.

The face is gone, but the boots are Merrick's. There's no sign of Aldous.

45.title: Discover Aldous's Fate
45.details:
Webbed footprints churn the mud around Merrick's body, and a second set of boots, a watchman's, leads away east along the shore toward the mirefin huts.

Aldous may have run, or been taken. Follow the trail to the mirefin village on the east shore.
45.objectives: Search the mirefin village on the east shore of the Mirrow Mere for Aldous, or signs of his fate.
45.completion:
Aldous lies among the reed huts with his sword still in his hand. He didn't go quietly.

His watch medallion hangs at his neck, and Merrick's is clutched in his fist. He must have taken it from his friend's body before they caught him.

71.title: Report to the Watchman
71.details:
The medallions are all that's left to bring home. Watchman Ashby will want them, and the families will want to know.

Take them back to his hut on the west shore.
71.objectives: Bring the Fallen Watchmen's Medallions to Watchman Colm Ashby at the Mirrow Mere.
71.completion:
Both of them. I knew it, the moment they didn't come back. I knew it.

Thank you for bringing them home. Their families should have these.

39.title: Deliver the Watchman's Report
39.details:
The marshal needs to hear this from someone who saw it. The fish-men have killed two of the watch, and they'll grow bolder if no one answers it.

Take my report to Marshal Thorne in Wexford. Tell him everything.
39.objectives: Report to Marshal Edric Thorne in Wexford.
39.completion:
Two good men. Aldous trained half the watch, and Merrick had a wife and a little one.

The mirefins will answer for this. You've done the watch a great service, and the watch looks after its own.

59.title: Cloth and Leather Armor
59.details:
You've earned better than the rags on your back. The watch keeps an account with Wenna Lisle, the seamstress here in the village.

Take this token to her. She'll fit you out with something sturdy, on the watch's coin.
59.objectives: Give the Wexford Armor Token to Wenna Lisle in Wexford.
59.progress: Is that a watch token you've got there?
59.completion:
A watch token, and from the marshal himself. You must have done something right.

Let's see. I've a few pieces that should fit you.

5545.title: A Bundle of Trouble
5545.details:
The prowlers and bears came down out of the woods at dawn and ran my cutters off before they could haul the day's work in. The wood's still out there, bundled and tied, lying where they dropped it.

I've a buyer in Wexford waiting on it. Gather up eight bundles from round the camp and bring them to me, and mind the beasts.
5545.objectives: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Foreman Edda Harlow at the Ashwood lumber camp.
5545.completion:
That's the lot of it. My buyer will be glad, and so am I.

Here, you've earned a share.

123.title: The Collector
123.details:
The ledger lists the farms of Harrowfield one by one, with the coin taken from each and the dates it was paid. Every page is signed the same way: the Collector.

Someone is squeezing the farmers, and the gnolls are carrying his money. The marshal in Wexford would want to see this.
123.objectives: Take The Collector's Itinerary to Marshal Edric Thorne in Wexford.
123.completion:
Where did you get this? Off a gnoll? Then the brigands and the gnolls are working together, and this Collector sits in the middle of it, taking his cut.

This is the first real lead we've had.

147.title: Manhunt
147.details:
The Collector has a name. Odo, they call him, a brigand who wears his rings over his gloves. The farmers say he holes up in Thornwick Tower, east of the mere, with a band of hedge-mages and cutthroats round him.

He's bled Harrowfield long enough. Find him, kill him, and bring me his signet ring as proof.
147.objectives: Kill Odo the Collector at Thornwick Tower, and bring The Collector's Signet to Marshal Edric Thorne in Wexford.
147.completion:
His signet. The farmers will sleep easier tonight, and so will I.

The watch's armory is open to you. Take what suits you.

787.title: The Proving Ground
787.details:
So you are the new blood. Good. The Horde has no use for the soft, and that is what the Proving Ground is for.

Commander Gorza Ironhand runs things here. You will find her in the yard, by the war drum. Go and show her you can walk that far without help.
787.objectives: Speak with Commander Gorza Ironhand at the Proving Ground.
787.completion:
Tarrok sent you? Then you can follow an order. That is a start.

Look around you. This canyon is hard, and it will teach you to be hard. Listen, fight, and come back alive, and the Horde will find a place for you.

788.title: Blooding the Blade
788.details:
Every warrior's first blood is drawn on something that bites back. The dustback boars root in the flats around the Proving Ground, and they have gored two of our peons this week.

Kill ten of them. Then come back and tell me what you learned.
788.objectives: Kill 10 Dustback Boars, then return to Commander Gorza Ironhand.
788.progress: The boars are still in the flats. Are you?
788.completion:
Ten boars, and you still have all your fingers. Good.

Take one of these. You will need better than rags before long.

789.title: Tails of the Sand
789.details:
The sand scorpions crawl over the rocks east of here, and their sting makes a grown orc sick for a day. Our healers grind the tails into a salve against the poison.

Bring me ten sand scorpion tails. Mind the stingers.
789.objectives: Bring 10 Sand Scorpion Tails to Commander Gorza Ironhand.
789.progress: The salve doesn't make itself. Have you got the tails?
789.completion:
Ten tails. The healers will be glad of these, and so will the next fool who gets stung.

Here, for your trouble.

4402.title: Cactus Apple Bake
4402.details:
You look hungry. Everyone looks hungry. Peons, grunts, the commander herself. And what do I have to cook with? Boar, boar, and more boar.

The cactus round the canyon bears a fat red apple, if you can pick it without losing a hand. Bring me ten, and I will make something that isn't boar.
4402.objectives: Gather 10 Cactus Apples from the cactus groves and bring them to Cook Galbrak.
4402.progress: No apples, no bake. Off you go.
4402.completion: Look at these! Ripe, every one. Here, take some of the first batch, and come back when you want more. Everyone will want more.

790.title: The Old Pincer
790.details:
You see this leg? A scorpion did this. Not one of the little ones on the rocks. A great old thing, red with age, the size of a cart. We call him Rustpincer.

He lairs on the ridge north of the cave. Kill him and bring me his claw, and I will know he is dead.
790.objectives: Kill Rustpincer on the ridge north of the Ember Cult Cave and bring his Mangled Claw to Tazula.
790.progress: Rustpincer still walks the ridge, mon. I can feel it.
790.completion:
His claw. You did it. Now I can sleep, and maybe walk again before long.

Take this to the commander. She will want to hear it from you.

804.title: Rustpincer's End
804.details:
Commander Gorza sent me out to the ridge to scout, and Rustpincer found me first. She will want to know the beast is dead, and who killed it.

Go and tell her. She will reward you better than I can.
804.objectives: Tell Commander Gorza Ironhand that Rustpincer is dead.
804.completion:
Rustpincer, dead? That old scorpion has crippled three of my scouts.

You have done the Proving Ground a service. Take your pick of these.

792.title: Ember Imps
792.details:
Something walks the far end of the canyon that does not belong in this world. Small burning things, all claws and laughter. Imps, called up by the cult that hides in the cave.

The cult is weak while its imps are few. Kill twelve of them, and come back to me.
792.objectives: Kill 12 Ember Imps in the east of Emberhollow, then return to Seer Morgha.
792.progress: I still hear them laughing in the dark. Twelve, I said.
792.completion:
The air is cleaner already. The spirits thank you, and so do I.

Choose a weapon. You will need one where you are going next.

794.title: The Cult's Medallion
794.details:
The imps were the servants. Their master is an orc who calls himself Vurrok Cinderhand, and he leads the Ember Cult's few here from the cave east of the Proving Ground.

Kill him. He wears a medallion of the cult; bring it to me, so I may learn what it is they serve.
794.objectives: Kill Vurrok Cinderhand in the Ember Cult Cave and bring his Medallion to Seer Morgha.
794.progress: Vurrok still breathes. I can smell his fires from here.
794.completion:
This is it. Cold, though it was worn against a living chest. There is old power in it, and none of it good.

You have done well. Take this.

805.title: To the Tidebone Village
805.details:
The medallion speaks of more of the cult than one cave can hold. They are on the coast too, I am sure of it, and the trolls of the Tidebone village have seen fires on the cliffs.

Go west through the pass to the Redsand Coast and find Elder Rokaji in the Tidebone village by the sea. Tell him what you found here.
805.objectives: Travel to the Tidebone village on the Redsand Coast and speak with Elder Rokaji.
805.completion:
Seer Morgha sends you? Then the cult is moving, as the spirits told me.

You have come far from the canyon, young one. Rest. The coast has work enough for you.

2161.title: Gruk's Burden
2161.details:
Me work, work, work. Now foreman want me carry this all the way to Spikewall. Too far! Me got work here.

You go that way? You take it. Give to Zarga at the inn. She know what it is.
2161.objectives: Take Gruk's Burden to Zarga Emberbrew at the inn in Spikewall.
2161.completion:
Gruk sent this all the way out with you? Lazy, that one, but honest.

Here, sit and have something. The road from the canyon is long.

784.title: Saltmarch Betrayers
784.details:
Humans landed on our coast south of here, sailors and marines from Saltmarch, and they have built themselves a keep. They say they are stranded. I say they are spies, and their lieutenant, Harwick, is the worst of them.

Go to the Stranded Keep. Kill ten sailors, eight marines, and Lieutenant Harwick himself.
784.objectives: Kill 10 Saltmarch Sailors, 8 Saltmarch Marines and Lieutenant Harwick at the Stranded Keep, then return to Commander Throgg.
784.progress: The humans are still on our coast. Why are you here?
784.completion:
Harwick is dead? Good. Let Saltmarch learn what it costs to sail where it is not welcome.

The Horde pays its warriors. Here.

825.title: Wreckage on the Beach
825.details:
The humans' ship broke on the rocks, and half its hold washed up on the beach by the keep. There were tinkers aboard, and tinkers carry tools. Good tools. I want them.

Bring me three of their tool kits from the wreckage.
825.objectives: Bring 3 Tinker's Tools from the wreckage on the beach below the Stranded Keep to Skrag Oilhand.
825.progress: No tools yet? The tide will take them if you wait.
825.completion:
Look at these! Fine work, every one. Saltmarch knows how to make a wrench, I'll give them that.

Take something from the pile. You earned it.

830.title: The Admiral's Orders
830.details:
The envelope is stained with salt and sealed with an admiral's mark. Inside are orders to the keep's lieutenant: hold the beach, learn the Horde's strength, and wait for the fleet.

The commander in Spikewall should see this.
830.objectives: Bring the Admiral's Sealed Orders to Commander Throgg in Spikewall.
830.completion:
Orders, sealed with the Saltmarch admiral's own mark. So they are not stranded at all.

You have done the Horde a great service by bringing this to me. It will go to Ironmaw Hold at once.

791.title: Canvas for the Walls
791.details:
Spikewall needs new awnings before the sand storms come, and we have no canvas. The humans at the keep have plenty, and so do the centaurs, who steal it from everyone.

Bring me eight canvas scraps, from whichever of them you like.
791.objectives: Bring 8 Canvas Scraps to Skrag Oilhand in Spikewall.
791.progress: The wind is coming, and the walls are bare.
791.completion: Good, good. Enough for the gate and the inn at least. Here.

823.title: Report to Spikewall
823.details:
You have outgrown the Proving Ground. The Redsand Coast is beyond the pass to the west, and Spikewall stands where the road comes down.

Seer Hrolga keeps the town's spirits and its secrets. Report to her. She has been asking for fighters.
823.objectives: Go west through the pass to Spikewall on the Redsand Coast and report to Seer Hrolga.
823.completion:
Gorza sent you? Then you have learned something already.

Sit. There is a darkness on this coast, and I need eyes and blades to find it.

806.title: Storms Over the Ridge
806.details:
Storms gather over Stormcrag Ridge, north of here, and they are not natural. The Ember Cult has a sorcerer there, Grizzle Ashtongue, who calls the lightning down.

Kill him, and bring me his claw. It is the source of his power.
806.objectives: Kill Grizzle Ashtongue on Stormcrag Ridge and bring Grizzle's Claw to Seer Hrolga.
806.progress: The storms still gather. Ashtongue still lives.
806.completion:
The claw. It still crackles. I will bury it where it can do no more harm.

The cult is bigger than one sorcerer, though. Speak with me again.

828.title: Old Ruzga
828.details:
An old shaman lives alone in a hut on the hills north of Spikewall. Ruzga. She fought the cult when I was a child, and she knows their ways better than anyone living.

Go to her. Tell her the cult is back.
828.objectives: Speak with Old Ruzga in her hut north of Spikewall.
828.completion:
Back, are they? I told them the cult was never gone. Nobody listens to old women.

Well, you came. That is something.

827.title: The Cave in the Skull
827.details:
The cult hides in a cave in the hills north of here, under a rock shaped like a skull. Its members wear searing collars, iron bands that burn with their master's fire.

Kill them and bring me six of those collars. I will learn who they serve from them.
827.objectives: Bring 6 Searing Collars from the Ember Cult at the Skull Rock cave to Old Ruzga.
827.progress: Six collars. The cult has many more than that.
827.completion:
These collars burn with a demon's fire. I feared as much.

Take a weapon. You will need it before this is done.

832.title: The Eye of the Cult
832.details:
The eye is a smooth black stone, warm to the touch, with a flame burning somewhere deep inside it. The Ember Cult's sign is carved round its rim.

Seer Hrolga in Spikewall would know what it is.
832.objectives: Bring the Eye of the Ember Cult to Seer Hrolga in Spikewall.
832.completion:
Where did you find this? Vozgul carried it? Then the cult's leaders on this coast are fewer by one.

I will study this eye. You have my thanks, and the Horde's.

808.title: Old Mother Wazi's Skull
808.details:
When Vazzar took the islands, he took the skull of Old Mother Wazi, our wisest seer, and caged it in his village to keep her spirit from us.

Go out to the islands, find the cage, and bring her skull home.
808.objectives: Bring Old Mother Wazi's Skull from the Tidebone Isles to Elder Rokaji.
808.progress: Her spirit cries out still. Bring her home, mon.
808.completion:
Old Mother Wazi. Home at last. Her spirit will guide us again.

Thank you. The Tidebone remember.

812.title: A Cure for Tazgo
812.details:
Ah, the poison. It burns, mon. A venomtail scorpion got me, out on the flats, and the healer says I have days, maybe less.

Healer Vashi can make an antidote, if someone brings her the poison sacs. Please. Help me.
812.objectives: Get a Venomtail Antidote from Healer Vashi and bring it to Tazgo.
812.progress: The fever is worse. Did Vashi make the cure?
812.completion:
The cure... I can feel it working already. You saved my life, stranger.

Take whatever you want of my things. I owe you more.

813.title: The Venomtail Antidote
813.details:
Tazgo will die without the antidote, and I cannot make it without venom. The venomtail scorpions on the flats south of the village carry poison sacs.

Bring me four, quickly.
813.objectives: Bring 4 Venomtail Poison Sacs to Healer Vashi.
813.progress: Tazgo does not have long. The sacs, mon.
813.completion: Four sacs. Good. Give me a moment, and you can take the antidote to Tazgo yourself.

815.title: Lasher Eggs
815.details:
The redclaw lashers lay their eggs in nests along the coast, and a lasher egg makes the best breakfast on the coast. Just ask anyone who's had one.

Bring me three.
815.objectives: Bring 3 Lasher Eggs from the lashers' nests to Cook Grunda in Spikewall.
815.completion: Three fine eggs! Here's your pay, and come by the inn in the morning.

816.title: Durn's Amulet
816.details:
My mate Durn went fishing on the river mouth south of here, and he never came back. The crocodiles took him. Mudjaws.

He wore an amulet I made him when we were young. If one of those mudjaws has it in its belly, bring it back to me.
816.objectives: Bring Durn's Amulet from the Mudjaw Crocodiles to Old Breka.
816.progress: Have you found it? The amulet?
816.completion:
His amulet. I can lay him to rest now, in my heart.

Thank you. Take this, and remember him.

817.title: Tiger Hunt
817.details:
The redsand tigers stalk the dry hills inland. A tiger's fur makes a fine cloak, and Spikewall's hunters need four more before the cold nights.

Bring me four furs.
817.objectives: Bring 4 Redsand Tiger Furs to Hunter Zekka.
817.completion: Four furs, clean cuts. You're a hunter after all. Here.

818.title: A Healer's Ingredients
818.details:
My salves need two things the shore is full of: the eyes of the clawfolk, intact mind you, and the slime of the shore crabs.

Bring me four eyes and eight measures of slime.
818.objectives: Bring 4 Intact Clawfolk Eyes and 8 Shore Crab Slime to Healer Vashi.
818.progress: Still need my eyes and slime, mon.
818.completion: Good! These will keep the village healthy for a season. Take this.

826.title: Vazzar
826.details:
Vazzar was one of us, before he turned to the dark. Now he holds the Tidebone Isles and his curses have bound our own people to him.

Go to the isles. Kill eight of his cursecallers, and free eight of the thralls the only way left. Then bring me Vazzar's head.
826.objectives: Kill 8 Cursecaller Trolls, 8 Thralled Trolls and Vazzar on the Tidebone Isles, and bring Vazzar's Head to Elder Rokaji.
826.completion:
It is done. The isles will be ours again, and our people can rest.

You have the thanks of the Tidebone, friend.

834.title: Stolen Supplies
834.details:
Those harpies on the cliffs raided my wagon! Five sacks of supplies, gone. Rope, wrenches, spare cogs, everything.

They stash what they steal round their nests. Get my sacks back, would you?
834.objectives: Recover 5 Sacks of Supplies from the harpies' cliffs and bring them to Rezzik Coppergear.
834.completion: Ha! My sacks! You're a lifesaver. Here's a little something.

835.title: Clipping Their Wings
835.details:
Getting my sacks back is one thing. Making sure those harpies don't take them again is another.

Kill twelve galecry savages and eight of their stormcallers. That ought to keep them off my wagon.
835.objectives: Kill 12 Galecry Savages and 8 Galecry Stormcallers on the harpies' cliffs, then return to Rezzik Coppergear.
835.progress: The harpies still screech over my wagon.
835.completion: Quiet at last. Pick something, pal. You've earned it.

837.title: Tuskfolk Encroachment
837.details:
The Thornhide tuskfolk are moving in from the dry gulch west of Spikewall, closer every week. They raid our caravans and drive off our herds.

Push them back. Four of each: their warriors, scouts, dustrunners and warguards.
837.objectives: Kill 4 Thornhide Tuskfolk, 4 Thornhide Scouts, 4 Thornhide Dustrunners and 4 Thornhide Warguards, then return to Commander Throgg.
837.completion: That will teach them to keep to their gulch. The Horde thanks you.

363.title: Rude Awakening
363.details:
Ah. Another one sits up. Don't be alarmed; the grave is a hard place to leave, and the first steps are the worst.

You are free now. Free of the plague's will, free of the master who raised you. What you do with that freedom is your own affair, but Dark Priest Halvard will want to see you. He waits in the chapel.
363.objectives: Speak with Dark Priest Halvard in the Gravesend Chapel.
363.completion:
Undertaker Voss sends another. Good. Every one of us who wakes with a will of their own is one more blow against those who would see us mindless.

Listen well. There is work here, and you are fit for it.

364.title: The Mindless Ones
364.details:
Not all who rise from the field wake as you did. Some wake empty, without a will, shambling about the old field south-east of the chapel and attacking anything that moves.

They cannot be saved. Put them down: eight of the mindless and eight of the wretched.
364.objectives: Kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies in the old field, then return to Dark Priest Halvard.
364.progress: They still shamble out there. Have you done what must be done?
364.completion:
It is grim work, but needful. They are at rest now, which is more than their masters ever gave them.

Take this. You will find the dead have little use for coin, but the living still trade.

3901.title: Rattling Bones
3901.details:
In the old crypts west of the chapel, the bones of the long dead have risen as well, held together by nothing but the old master's spite.

Break twelve of the Rattlebone skeletons and come back to me.
3901.objectives: Kill 12 Rattlebone Skeletons at the old crypts, then return to Dark Priest Halvard.
3901.completion: The crypts are quiet again. Well done.

376.title: The Damned
376.details:
Our scavengers' paws and the gloombats' wings are useful to us, in the making of what keeps our bodies from falling apart. The beasts roam the glade freely.

Bring me six scavenger paws and six gloombat wings.
376.objectives: Bring 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Gloombat Wings to Acolyte Rennick.
376.progress: Six of each. I can't do my work without them.
376.completion: Good, good. These will serve. Your body will thank you, if it can still thank anyone.

3902.title: Scavenging Gravesend
3902.details:
The hamlet east of the chapel was abandoned in a hurry. Its people left their stores behind: boxes of tools, cloth and food we could use.

Search the ruined hamlet. Bring me six bundles of whatever you find.
3902.objectives: Bring 6 Scavenged Goods from the ruined hamlet to Deathwatch Corvin.
3902.completion: Not much, but more than we had. Every scrap counts when the living won't trade with you.

380.title: The Webbed Vault
380.details:
Spiders have nested in the cave in the northern hill. We call it the Webbed Vault, though it was a mine once. They grow bold, and they grow many.

Thin them out: ten of the young and eight of the grown ones.
380.objectives: Kill 10 Young Duskweb Spiders and 8 Duskweb Spiders at the Webbed Vault, then return to Executor Varlan.
380.progress: The spiders still come out at night.
380.completion: The vault will be quieter for a while. You are useful. I have more for you.

381.title: The Sunward Crusade
381.details:
Zealots of the Sunward Crusade have pitched a camp in the south-east of the glade. They believe the risen are an abomination to be burned, every one, whether or not we have our wills.

Show them otherwise. Bring me twelve of their armbands.
381.objectives: Bring 12 Sunward Armbands from the Sunward camp to Executor Varlan.
381.progress: The crusaders still camp in our glade.
381.completion: Twelve. They will think twice before they burn the next of us.

382.title: The Red Messenger
382.details:
A messenger of the Crusade, one Merrick Vossen, carries orders between the camp and their abbey in Duskmoor. Those orders would tell us much.

Kill him and bring me what he carries.
382.objectives: Kill Merrick Vossen at the Sunward camp and bring his documents to Executor Varlan.
382.completion: The Crusade's documents. Sealed, but seals are no trouble.

383.title: Vital Intelligence
383.details:
These documents speak of the Crusade's plans for all of Duskmoor. Executor Mortlake in Gallowfield must see them.

Take the road east through the pass. Gallowfield is where it meets the crossroads.
383.objectives: Take the Sunward Crusade Documents to Executor Mortlake in Gallowfield, in Duskmoor Glades.
383.completion:
Varlan sent these? Then he has done well, and so have you.

The Crusade grows bolder. Welcome to Gallowfield. We will need you.

427.title: At War With the Sunward Crusade
427.details:
The Crusade has a watch north of the pass road, and its warriors ride out to burn any of us they catch on the roads.

Go to the Sunward watch and kill ten of their warriors.
427.objectives: Kill 10 Sunward Warriors at the Sunward watch, then return to Executor Mortlake.
427.completion: Ten. That is a start. The Crusade has captains, though, and the captains are the real threat.

370.title: At War With the Sunward Crusade
370.details:
The first of their captains, Lisette, runs a mission in the south-west where the Crusade's preachers train. She has sent zealots and missionaries to hunt us.

Kill her, and three of each of her zealots and missionaries.
370.objectives: Kill Captain Lisette, 3 Sunward Zealots and 3 Sunward Missionaries, then return to Executor Mortlake.
370.completion: Lisette is dead. Her mission will scatter.

371.title: At War With the Sunward Crusade
371.details:
Captain Vossel holds the east watch with friars of the Crusade's abbey. They have blocked the east road.

Kill Vossel and five of his friars.
371.objectives: Kill Captain Vossel and 5 Sunward Friars, then return to Executor Mortlake.
371.progress: The east road is still shut.
371.completion: The east road is open again. One captain left.

372.title: At War With the Sunward Crusade
372.details:
The last of them, Captain Merrin, holds the door of the Zealot Abbey in the north-east with two bodyguards at his side.

Kill him and both his guards. Then the Crusade will know we are not prey.
372.objectives: Kill Captain Merrin and 2 Sunward Bodyguards at the Zealot Abbey, then return to Executor Mortlake.
372.progress: Merrin still holds the abbey door.
372.completion: Merrin is dead. The Crusade will be some time recovering from this. Gallowfield owes you.

374.title: Proof of Demise
374.details:
Every crusader wears a ring of the Sunward order. Bring me ten of them, as proof of how many have fallen.

The Crusade pays the living to bring in our heads. We pay for theirs.
374.objectives: Bring 10 Sunward Insignia Rings to Deathwatch Halloran.
374.completion: Ten rings. Here is your bounty.

358.title: Graverobbers
358.details:
The Grimhide gnolls dig up our dead and carry off the bodies, and the embalming fluids we use to keep them whole.

Kill eight of their graverobbers and five of their mongrels, and bring back eight measures of embalming ichor they've stolen.
358.objectives: Kill 8 Grimhide Graverobbers and 5 Grimhide Mongrels and bring 8 Embalming Ichor to Magistrate Corvane.
358.completion: They will think twice before robbing our graves again. Thank you.

365.title: Fields of Grief
365.details:
The Plaguewood farms south of town still grow pumpkins, though no living hand tends them now. We could use them.

Bring me ten pumpkins from the fields.
365.objectives: Bring 10 Duskmoor Pumpkins from the Plaguewood farms to Gravekeeper Hettle.
365.completion: Fine ones! Even the dead can appreciate a good pumpkin.

404.title: A Putrid Task
404.details:
The rotting dead in the Plaguewood farms are not like us. They're mindless, and diseased, and their claws carry the plague.

Bring me seven of their putrid claws. I need to study the disease.
404.objectives: Bring 7 Putrid Claws from the dead of the Plaguewood farms to Edwin Farrow.
404.completion: Seven. Thank you. Mind you wash your hands. Well, whatever you have left of them.

426.title: The Mills Overrun
426.details:
The Ashworth mills to the north-west are overrun by skeletons. I want to know what binds them.

Bring me five notched ribs from the soldiers there and three blackened skulls from their bonecasters.
426.objectives: Bring 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls from the Ashworth mills to Edwin Farrow.
426.completion: Fascinating. These are bound by something old. Thank you.

362.title: The Haunted Mills
362.details: The Ashworths owned the mills before the plague came. Young Dorian Ashworth haunts the mill still. Lay him to rest, and bring me his remains.
362.objectives: Kill Dorian Ashworth at the Ashworth mills and bring his remains to Edwin Farrow.

354.title: Deaths in the Family
354.details:
The rest of the Ashworth family haunts their manor north-west of the mills: Gerran, Nessa and Thomas. They knew me once, when they were alive.

Put them to rest, and bring me their remains.
354.objectives: Bring Gerran's, Nessa's and Thomas's Remains from the Ashworth manor to Edwin Farrow.
354.completion: All three. I knew them, you know. Kind people. They didn't deserve this.

355.title: Speak with Corvane
355.details:
The Ashworths had a family crypt beyond their manor, and there is something worse in it. Magistrate Corvane will want to know.

Go and tell him what you've seen.
355.objectives: Speak with Magistrate Corvane in Gallowfield.
355.completion: The Ashworth crypt. I feared as much.

408.title: The Family Crypt
408.details:
Captain Morrow served the Ashworths in life, and now holds their crypt with their ancestors' restless dead.

Go to the crypt. Kill eight of the wailing and eight of the rotting ancestors, and bring me Morrow's skull.
408.objectives: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors at the Ashworth crypt and bring Morrow's Skull to Magistrate Corvane.
408.completion: Morrow's skull. The crypt is at peace. Gallowfield thanks you.

375.title: The Chill of Death
375.details:
The nights are cold in Duskmoor, even for those of us who don't feel it any more. I'm making cloaks for the deathwatch.

Bring me five gloombat pelts and a spool of coarse thread from the provisioner.
375.objectives: Bring 5 Gloombat Pelts and 1 Coarse Thread to Morwen Gallow at the inn.
375.completion: Lovely. The deathwatch will be warm, whether they can tell or not.

398.title: Wanted: Rotjaw
398.details:
Rotjaw leads the Grimhide gnolls from their camp in the east. As long as he lives, they'll keep digging up our dead.

Kill him and bring me his paw.
398.objectives: Kill Rotjaw at the Grimhide camp and bring his paw to Deathwatch Halloran.
398.completion: Rotjaw's paw. Good. The gnolls will scatter now.

356.title: Rear Guard Patrol
356.details:
The east barricade holds back what comes from the plagued lands beyond: horrors that bleed without dying and spirits that wander without rest.

Go to the barricade. Kill eight of each.
356.objectives: Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits at the east barricade, then return to Deathwatch Halloran.

367.title: A New Plague
367.details:
The living made a plague to kill us all. I'm making one of my own. It needs the blood of darkhounds.

Bring me five vials of darkhound blood.
367.objectives: Bring 5 Darkhound Blood to Apothecary Vesk.
367.completion: Five. Excellent. Now we need the next ingredient.

368.title: A New Plague
368.details: The Murkfin fish-men of Lake Hollowmere have scales that hold a peculiar toxin. Bring me five.
368.objectives: Bring 5 Murkfin Scales from Lake Hollowmere to Apothecary Vesk.

369.title: A New Plague
369.details: The last ingredient: the venom of the vicious Duskweb spiders in the south-east woods. Four sacs of it.
369.objectives: Bring 4 Vicious Duskweb Spider Venom to Apothecary Vesk.
369.completion: Perfect. My plague is nearly ready. Thank you, friend. The living will regret making the first one.

5481.title: Thrum's Task
5481.details:
Thrum hungry. Thrum likes gloom weed. Grows round the graveyard.

You get three for Thrum?
5481.objectives: Bring 3 Gloom Weed from round Gallowfield's graveyard to Thrum.

5482.title: Doom Weed
5482.details:
Thrum still hungry. Doom weed is better than gloom weed. Grows below big abbey, where the crusaders are.

You get ten?
5482.objectives: Bring 10 Doom Weed from below the Zealot Abbey to Thrum.
5482.completion: Ten doom weed! Thrum very happy now.

747.title: The Hunt Begins
747.details:
Every young Hornkin proves themselves first in the hunt. The tallbirds graze in the fields round the camp; they are swift but not clever.

Bring me seven of their meat and seven of their feathers.
747.objectives: Bring 7 Tallbird Meat and 7 Tallbird Feathers to Grull Skymane.
747.completion: A good start. The hunt is in your blood.

750.title: The Hunt Continues
750.details:
The cougars of the western hills are a greater test. They hunt the hunters.

Bring me ten of their pelts.
750.objectives: Bring 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts from the western hills to Grull Skymane.

780.title: The Battleboars
780.details:
The battleboars of the south-western meadow are fierce. Their snouts and flanks feed the camp through the winter.

Bring me eight of each.
780.objectives: Bring 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks to Grull Skymane.
780.completion: Eight of each. The camp will eat well.

752.title: A Humble Task
752.details: Chief Skymane asked me to send him the next young one who came by. That's you. He is in front of the longhouse.
752.objectives: Speak with Chief Skymane in front of the longhouse.
752.completion: Ah, you've come. Good. There is something I would ask of you.

753.title: A Humble Task
753.details:
My old bones are thirsty, and the Wellspring north of the camp gives the purest water in all the plains.

Bring me a pitcher of it.
753.objectives: Bring a Water Pitcher from the Wellspring to Chief Skymane.
753.completion: Ahh. Pure as the first morning. Thank you, young one.

755.title: Rites of the Earthmother
755.details:
You have shown patience. Now you are ready for the rites of our people.

Seer Sunwalker waits by the great totem. Go to her.
755.objectives: Speak with Seer Sunwalker by the great totem.
755.completion: The chief sends you. The Earthmother has her eye on you, young one.

757.title: Rite of Strength
757.details:
The Briartusk tuskfolk camp in the Thornback Ravine to the south-east. They raid our camp and steal our herds.

Prove your strength against them. Bring me twelve of their belts.
757.objectives: Bring 12 Briartusk Belts from the Thornback Ravine to Seer Sunwalker.
757.completion: Twelve belts. You are strong. The Earthmother is pleased.

763.title: Rites of the Earthmother
763.details:
You are ready to leave the camp. Take this totem to Chief Longhorn in Longhorn Village, up the pass to the north, in the Tallgrass.

He will know what it means.
763.objectives: Take the Totem of Skymane to Chief Longhorn in Longhorn Village, in the Tallgrass.
763.completion:
The totem of Skymane. So the young one has passed the rites of the camp.

Welcome to Longhorn Village.

781.title: Attack on Sunfold
781.details:
The plans are drawn on a scrap of hide in the tuskfolk's crude marks: Sunfold Camp, and arrows pointing at it from the ravine.

Chief Skymane must see this.
781.objectives: Take the Briartusk Attack Plans to Chief Skymane.
781.completion: They mean to attack the camp? Then we strike first. You have done well to bring this to me.

3376.title: Break Ragetusk!
3376.details:
Chief Ragetusk leads the Briartusk from the depths of the Thornback Ravine. While he lives, the raids will never stop.

Kill him. Bring me his head.
3376.objectives: Kill Chief Ragetusk in the Thornback Ravine and bring his head to Brave Windfeather.
3376.completion: His head. The Briartusk will scatter. You are a true brave.

1656.title: A Task Unfinished
1656.details:
I have a bundle of furs for Moro Plainsong in Longhorn Village, and I can't leave the camp.

Will you take them to him?
1656.objectives: Take the Bundle of Furs to Moro Plainsong in Longhorn Village.
1656.completion: Tahna's furs! Fine ones. Thank you.

743.title: Dangers of the Skyrend
743.details:
The Skyrend harpies nest on the cliffs to the west and swoop down on our herds and hunters.

Bring me eight of their talons.
743.objectives: Bring 8 Skyrend Talons from the Skyrend cliffs to Chief Longhorn.
743.completion: Eight talons. Our hunters will walk safer.

745.title: Sharing the Land
745.details:
The Dustmane gnolls at Ashmane Rock hunt our herds for their hides. The land is shared, but not with them.

Kill ten of their tanners, eight of their skinners and five of their poachers.
745.objectives: Kill 10 Dustmane Tanners, 8 Dustmane Skinners and 5 Dustmane Poachers at Ashmane Rock, then return to Brave Stormhide.
745.progress: The gnolls still hunt our herds.
745.completion: The herds are safer. Well done.

748.title: Poison Water
748.details:
The wells of the plains are being poisoned, and the beasts that drink there sicken. I must know the poison.

Bring me six prairie wolf paws and four tallbird talons.
748.objectives: Bring 6 Prairie Wolf Paws and 4 Tallbird Talons to Elder Thunderhoof.
748.completion: I see it now. Something foul in the water. We will cleanse it.

761.title: Swoop Hunting
761.details:
The swoops are great birds of the plains, and their quills make fine trophies.

Bring me eight.
761.objectives: Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Huntress Kenna Swiftmane.
761.completion: Eight fine quills. You hunt well.

766.title: Thunderstrider
766.details:
There is a beast on the plains we call Thunderstrider, old and huge. To hunt him you must know the plains. Bring me a heart from a prairie wolf, a femur from a flatland cougar, a scale from a tallbird and a gizzard from a swoop.

Then you will be ready.
766.objectives: Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, a Flatland Cougar Femur, a Tallbird Scale and a Swoop Gizzard to Huntress Kenna Swiftmane.
766.progress: Do you know the plains yet?
766.completion: You know the plains. Now you are a hunter.

767.title: Rite of Vision
767.details: The Rite of Vision is the next of our rites. Seer Twomoons keeps the wells to the north. Go to him.
767.objectives: Speak with Seer Twomoons at the Seers' wells.
767.completion: Thunderhoof sends you. Good. The rite is old, and needs old things.

771.title: Rite of Vision
771.details:
For the rite I need two well stones from the wells, and two amberseeds from the grass around them.

Bring them to me.
771.objectives: Bring 2 Well Stones and 2 Amberseed to Seer Twomoons.
771.completion: Good. Now I can prepare the water of the seers. Rest, and the vision will come.

770.title: The Demon Scarred Cloak
770.details:
The cloak is old and torn, scarred by claws that weren't a beast's. There is a Hornkin hunter's mark sewn inside it.

Someone in Longhorn Village might know whose it was.
770.objectives: Take the Demon Scarred Cloak to Huntress Kenna Swiftmane in Longhorn Village.
770.completion:
That cloak... it belonged to a hunter who went after the Pale Howler and never came back.

You killed the beast? Then he is avenged. Thank you.

833.title: A Sacred Burial
833.details:
The Ochre Stones are our sacred burial ground, and the Briartusk dig among the graves for trinkets.

Drive them out. Kill eight of the interlopers.
833.objectives: Kill 8 Briartusk Interlopers at the Ochre Stones, then return to Lorekeeper Rainsong.
833.progress: They still dig among the graves.
833.completion: The dead rest easier. Thank you.

861.title: The Hunter's Way
861.details:
The flatland prowlers are the most cunning cats on the plains. A true hunter can bring down four of them.

Bring me their claws.
861.objectives: Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Huntress Kenna Swiftmane.
861.completion: Four claws. You walk the hunter's way.

179.title: Dwarven Outfitters
179.details:
Welcome to the Hollow Hall, lad. Or lass. Can't tell under all that frost.

First thing anyone learns here is to keep warm and keep fed. The ragged wolves out in the snow are tough old things, but their meat makes a fine stew and their hides line a good pair of boots.

Bring me eight pieces of tough wolf meat and I'll see you outfitted proper.
179.objectives: Bring 8 Tough Wolf Meat to Torvi Stonearm at the Hollow Hall.
179.progress: Wolves are all about the hall. Don't let them chew on you.
179.completion:
Eight! Good work. That'll keep the pot full a week.

Here, take something for the cold. You'll want it before long.

170.title: A New Threat
170.details:
Troggs. Stonejaw troggs, digging up out of the mountain north-east of the hall like they own the place. Filthy, stupid, and strong as rams, and more of them every day.

I want them pushed back. Go to their diggings and kill six of the troggs and six of the burly ones.
170.objectives: Kill 6 Stonejaw Troggs and 6 Burly Stonejaw Troggs at the trogg diggings, then return to Baldur Frostbeard.
170.progress: The diggings are north-east of the hall. Mind the burly ones.
170.completion: That'll teach them to come knocking. Well fought.

183.title: The Boar Hunter
183.details:
The small crag boars are getting into everything: the stores, the traps, my good boots. They root about the slopes south-west of the hall in packs.

Thin them out for me. Twelve of them ought to do it.
183.objectives: Kill 12 Small Crag Boars, then return to Tavin Sharpeye at his camp west of the Hollow Hall.
183.completion: Twelve boars. You've a hunter's patience. Here, for your trouble.

233.title: Frosthollow Mail Delivery
233.details:
Now you've got your feet under you, make yourself useful. The post's come down from Kettlefold, and Tavin Sharpeye's camp is out west of the hall.

Take him this stack of letters. He'll pass the rest along.
233.objectives: Deliver the stack of letters to Tavin Sharpeye, west of the Hollow Hall.
233.completion:
Letters! It's been weeks. Thanks, friend.

There's one in here for Gerrin, too. Don't suppose you're going that way?

234.title: Frosthollow Mail Delivery
234.details:
This one's for Gerrin Greymantle. He's camped north-west of the hall, under the Troll Caves, keeping an eye on the Icemane.

It's sealed, so it's important, or he thinks it is.
234.objectives: Deliver the letter to Gerrin Greymantle at his camp below the Troll Caves.
234.completion:
From Kettlefold? Ah, at last. They've finally answered.

Thank you. Stay a while. I could use someone handy.

3361.title: A Refugee's Quandary
3361.details:
Oh! Oh, you're a dwarf. Or a gnome. Either way, splendid! I'm Fenwick. I fled the trouble in the Cogworks with everything I owned, and then I lost everything I owned in the snow.

My box is somewhere by the Troll Caves, my chest by the trogg diggings, and my bucket of bolts up on the Frozen Stair. Could you fetch them?
3361.objectives: Bring Fenwick's Box, Fenwick's Chest and Fenwick's Bucket of Bolts to Fenwick Sprocketbolt at the Hollow Hall.
3361.progress: Any luck? The bolts especially. They're very good bolts.
3361.completion:
My things! All of them! You're a marvel.

Please, take this. It's not much, but I insist.

182.title: The Troll Cave
182.details:
I came here to study the Icemane trolls. I've learned they breed fast and fight dirty. Their young swarm out of the caves above my camp day and night.

Kill fourteen of the troll whelps. Keep them from growing up into worse.
182.objectives: Kill 14 Icemane Troll Whelps at the Troll Caves, then return to Gerrin Greymantle.
182.progress: The caves are just up the slope. Watch the novices; they throw ice.
182.completion:
Fourteen. That should give us some quiet.

But I fear the worst is still in there.

218.title: The Stolen Journal
218.details:
While I was out, a troll broke into my camp and took my journal: years of notes on the Icemane. His name's Grisknar the Cold. He lords it over the whelps deep in the caves.

Kill him and bring my journal back.
218.objectives: Kill Grisknar the Cold in the Troll Caves and bring Gerrin Greymantle's Journal back to him.
218.progress: Grisknar's in the back of the caves. You'll know him by the cold.
218.completion: My journal! And barely torn. You've done me a great turn.

282.title: Sennar's Observations
282.details:
My journal says the Icemane in these caves are only an outpost. Their real hold is out in Highpeak, south-west of Kettlefold.

Take my report to Mountaineer Haldor. He keeps watch at the top of the Frozen Stair, east of the hall, and he'll know where to send it.
282.objectives: Take Gerrin's Report to Mountaineer Haldor at the Frozen Stair.
282.completion:
A report from Gerrin? Let's see.

Hmm. This is for Sennar's eyes, not mine.

420.title: Sennar's Observations
420.details:
Sennar Greymantle, Gerrin's brother, keeps an eye on the trolls from Kettlefold. Take this report to him.

The Frozen Stair goes east through the mountains and down into Highpeak. Follow the road and you'll walk right into the village.
420.objectives: Take Gerrin's Report to Sennar Greymantle in Kettlefold, in Highpeak.
420.completion:
From my brother! He always did write too much.

But this is useful. Very useful. Thank you.

3364.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery
3364.details:
Dunstan at the hall's been up since before dawn and hasn't had a drop. I've brewed him my scalding mornbrew, the finest thing to keep a dwarf on his feet.

Take it to him while it's hot, would you? He's the tanner by the hall's door.
3364.objectives: Take the Scalding Mornbrew to Dunstan Hidecutter at the Hollow Hall.
3364.completion:
Is that Nessa's mornbrew? Bless her!

Ah. Just the thing. Still warm, too.

3365.title: Bring Back the Mug
3365.details: Nessa'll want her mug back; she's particular about it. Would you take it to her? She's at Gerrin's camp.
3365.objectives: Return Nessa's Mug to Nessa Stoutbrew at Gerrin's camp.
3365.completion: My mug! He drank it all, I hope? Good. Thank you.

2160.title: Supplies to Tannar
2160.details:
The Thornbrew inn in Kettlefold is waiting on this crate of supplies, and I'm waiting on someone to carry it. You look strong.

Take it to Tannar Frostbeard at the inn. The road goes east up the Frozen Stair into Highpeak.
2160.objectives: Take the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannar Frostbeard at the inn in Kettlefold, in Highpeak.
2160.completion:
The supplies! Belva was starting to worry.

Come in, warm yourself. You've earned it.

400.title: Tools for Steelgrip
400.details:
Belgar Steelgrip runs the depot east of Kettlefold, where the gnomes keep their flying machines. He sent these tools to me for mending and now they're good as new.

Take them back to him when you go to Highpeak.
400.objectives: Take Steelgrip's Tools to Belgar Steelgrip at Steelgrip's Depot, east of Kettlefold.
400.completion: My tools! Lodrin's done a fine job. Thank you.

317.title: Stocking the Jetstream
317.details:
I'm Pilot Pumpwhistle, and that's the Jetstream, the finest flying machine in Highpeak. I'm planning a long flight and I'll need provisions: boar meat for the trip, bear fur to keep me warm up there.

Four chunks of boar meat and two thick bear furs, please.
317.objectives: Bring 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs to Pilot Pumpwhistle at Steelgrip's Depot.
317.progress: Meat and fur. The sky is cold, you know.

318.title: Evershine
318.details:
There's one more thing. Nothing keeps a pilot's spirits up like a cask of Evershine, and the only brewer who makes it is Rodvar Barleyhall, up on the shore of the Icewater Tarn north of Kettlefold.

Go and get me a cask.
318.objectives: Get a cask of Evershine from Rodvar Barleyhall in Barleyhall.
318.completion: Evershine? For Pumpwhistle? Ha! He'll have to wait.

319.title: A Favor for Evershine
319.details:
I'd give you the cask, but my brewing's gone to pot. The ice claw bears, the elder crag boars and the snow leopards keep raiding my barley and scaring off my help.

Thin them out. Six bears, eight boars, eight leopards. Then we'll talk.
319.objectives: Kill 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars and 8 Snow Leopards, then return to Rodvar Barleyhall.
319.completion: That's better. A dwarf can brew in peace now.

320.title: Return to Pumpwhistle
320.details: Here's your cask of Evershine. Tell Pumpwhistle it's the good stuff, and not to drink it all before he takes off.
320.objectives: Take the Cask of Evershine to Pilot Pumpwhistle at Steelgrip's Depot.
320.completion: Evershine! You're a hero to pilots everywhere.

384.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
384.details: There's nothing finer than boar ribs basted in malt. I'll cook you some if you bring me what I need: six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt. Belva sells the malt here at the inn.
384.objectives: Bring 6 Crag Boar Ribs and 1 Rhapsody Malt to Ragnor Kegsworth at the inn in Kettlefold.
384.completion: Now that's a meal. Take a few for the road.

313.title: The Grizzled Den
313.details:
The wendigos lair in the Grizzled Den, north-west of Kettlefold. Their manes make the best lining for a pilot's coat.

Bring me eight wendigo manes.
313.objectives: Bring 8 Wendigo Manes to Pilot Gearbolt at Steelgrip's Depot.
313.completion: Eight manes. My coat will be the warmest in Highpeak.

314.title: Protecting the Herd
314.details:
Something's been taking my rams. A great yeti, Vaskar, prowls the hills by the ranch. He's taken three this month.

Kill him and bring me his fang.
314.objectives: Kill Vaskar near Amberfield Ranch and bring his fang to Rudhild Amberfield.
314.progress: Vaskar's still out there. I can hear him.
314.completion: The fang of Vaskar. My herd is safe. Thank you.

315.title: The Perfect Stout
315.details:
I've a new brew in mind: a stout with a shimmer to it. It needs shimmerweed, which only grows on Shimmer Ridge, south-west of Kettlefold, where the Icemane seers pick it.

Bring me six.
315.objectives: Bring 6 Shimmerweed to Rodvar Barleyhall in Barleyhall.
315.completion: Lovely. Smell that! This will be my finest brew.

413.title: Shimmer Stout
413.details: Here it is: my shimmer stout. My cousin, Mountaineer Barleyhall, stands guard at the Anvilhold Gate north of here. He'll want the first barrel.
413.objectives: Take the Barrel of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Barleyhall at the Anvilhold Gate.
413.completion: Shimmer stout! My cousin's outdone himself.

412.title: Operation Recombobulation
412.details:
The Cogworks, our great works in the north-west, were lost to a terrible accident. The gnomes who stayed were blighted by it, and they've gone strange.

They carry the parts I need to fix our machines: restabilization cogs and gyromechanic gears. Bring me eight of each.
412.objectives: Bring 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears to Razzik Sprywrench at Steelgrip's Depot.
412.completion: Perfect! With these, we'll be back in the sky in no time.

432.title: Those Blasted Troggs!
432.details:
The Grey Quarry was ours until the troggs dug up into it. Now we can't swing a pick without a skullthumper swinging back.

Kill six skullthumpers.
432.objectives: Kill 6 Stonejaw Skullthumpers at the Grey Quarry, then return to Foreman Flintbrow.
432.progress: The quarry's still full of them.
432.completion: Six. The lads can get back to work.

433.title: The Public Servant
433.details:
The bonesnappers are the worst of the troggs at the quarry. As a servant of the people, I must see them dealt with.

By you. Ten of them.
433.objectives: Kill 10 Stonejaw Bonesnappers at the Grey Quarry, then return to Senator Mehrin Stonevale.
433.completion: Well done! The people thank you, as do I.

287.title: Icemane Hold
287.details:
My brother's report says the Icemane are gathering at their hold south-west of Kettlefold. I want to know how many there are.

Go to Icemane Hold and look round. And kill five of their headhunters while you're there; they've been hunting our people.
287.objectives: Explore Icemane Hold and kill 5 Icemane Headhunters, then return to Sennar Greymantle in Kettlefold.
287.progress: The hold is south-west, under the cliffs.
287.completion: That many? Then we'll need more than a watch. Thank you.

419.title: The Lost Pilot
419.details:
My friend Hildra flew out over the eastern pines a week ago and never came back. I fear the worst.

She was headed east, toward the Southgate. Find her.
419.objectives: Find Pilot Hildra, east of Kettlefold near the Southgate.
419.completion: Here, in the snow, is what is left of Pilot Hildra. Her flying machine lies wrecked beside her, and her journal is still in her hand.

417.title: A Pilot's Revenge
417.details:
Hildra's journal says she came down safely, but something hunted her: a great bear with a mangy hide, Scabclaw.

The beast must be near. Kill it and bring its claw and Hildra's journal to Pilot Hammerwick at the Grey Quarry.
417.objectives: Kill Scabclaw and bring his Mangy Claw and Hildra's Journal to Pilot Hammerwick at the Grey Quarry.
417.completion:
Hildra's journal. And the beast's claw.

She's avenged, then. Thank you.

312.title: Mackellen's Stolen Stash
312.details:
Old Rimebeard, the biggest wendigo in the Grizzled Den, broke into my meat locker and dragged the whole thing back to his cave!

Get my dried meats back. The cave's at the back of the den.
312.objectives: Retrieve Haggar Mackellen's dried meats from his meat locker at Old Rimebeard's cave.
312.completion: My meats! Untouched! You're a true friend.

5541.title: Ammo for Thundershot
5541.details:
Hegrun Thundershot's camped at the Grey Quarry, shooting troggs, and he's run dry. I sent a crate of shot down to him, but the troggs got it first.

Find the crate in the quarry and take it to Hegrun.
5541.objectives: Find the ammo crate at the Grey Quarry and bring Thundershot's Ammo to Hegrun Thundershot.
5541.progress: The crate's somewhere in the quarry.
5541.completion: Ammo! Now I can get back to work. Thank you.

458.title: The Woodland Protector
458.details:
Welcome, child of the stars. You have woken beneath the Elderbough, and there is much to learn.

Thalindra, a dryad of the glen, watches over the woods to the west. Go and speak with her. She has need of you.
458.objectives: Speak with Thalindra in her grove west of the Elderbough.
458.completion: You have come. Good. The woods are troubled, and I cannot mend them alone.

459.title: The Woodland Protector
459.details:
The fenlings round the Shadowrock to the south-west carry fel moss, a foul growth that sickens the glen.

Gather eight clumps of it from them, so that I may cleanse it.
459.completion: Eight. I will burn it in moonlight. Thank you, young one.

456.title: The Balance of Nature
456.details:
The young shadecats and thistle boars of the glen have grown too many, and the balance of nature is upset.

Hunt seven young shadecats and four young thistle boars.
456.objectives: Kill 7 Young Shadecats and 4 Young Thistle Boars, then return to Conservator Ilanthe.

457.title: The Balance of Nature
457.details:
The grown beasts are worse: mangy shadecats and thistle boars in the glades to the north.

Seven of each.
457.objectives: Kill 7 Mangy Shadecats and 7 Thistle Boars, then return to Conservator Ilanthe.
457.completion: The balance is restored. Well done.

916.title: Silkwood Venom
916.details:
Silkwood spiders nest in the Silkhollow, the cave south-east of here. Their venom is potent, and I would study it.

Bring me ten venom sacs.
916.objectives: Bring 10 Silkwood Venom Sacs to Gilthan Windstride at the Elderbough.
916.progress: The spiders are in the Silkhollow.
916.completion: Ten. This will help me understand their poison.

917.title: Silkwood Egg
917.details:
The venom tells me the spiders are changing. I need to see one of their eggs.

The eggs are deep in the Silkhollow, guarded by Sissith the Vile. Bring me one.
917.objectives: Bring a Silkwood Egg from the Silkhollow to Gilthan Windstride.
917.progress: An egg, from deep in the cave.
917.completion: An egg. Yes, they are changing. I must think on this.

4495.title: A Good Friend
4495.details:
My friend Iveran went to watch the spiders at the Silkhollow and hasn't come back. I'm worried.

Would you find him? He'd be near the mouth of the cave, south-east of here.
4495.completion:
Dirana sent you? Bless her.

I'm... not well. The spiders bit me.

3519.title: A Friend in Need
3519.details: I've been poisoned. I can't walk far. Please, tell Dirana. She knows how to make an antidote.
3519.objectives: Tell Dirana Silverleaf at the Elderbough that Iveran is poisoned.
3519.completion: Poisoned? Then there is no time to waste.

3521.title: Iveran's Antidote
3521.details:
To make the antidote I need hyacinth mushrooms, which grow round the Shadowrock, moonpetal lilies from the lily pool east of the Elderbough, and the ichor of a Silkwood spider.

Seven mushrooms, four lilies and one ichor. Quickly.
3521.objectives: Bring 7 Hyacinth Mushrooms, 4 Moonpetal Lilies and 1 Silkwood Ichor to Dirana Silverleaf.

3522.title: Iveran's Antidote
3522.details: Here is the antidote. Take it to Iveran by the Silkhollow, and be quick.
3522.objectives: Take Iveran's Antidote to Iveran by the Silkhollow.
3522.completion: The antidote... already the pain is fading. Thank you, friend.

2159.title: Fernwatch Delivery
2159.details:
Keldara, the innkeeper at Fernwatch, has been waiting on this delivery.

Fernwatch is south, down the roots of the Elderbough onto Eldergrove Isle. Follow the road.
2159.objectives: Take the Fernwatch Delivery to Keldara at the inn in Fernwatch, on Eldergrove Isle.
2159.completion: My delivery! Thank you. Rest here a while.

488.title: Zann's Bidding
488.details:
You there. Yes, you. I am Zann Rothoof. The elves won't let me into their village, but you might help me.

I need three shadecat fangs, three strigid owl feathers and three swatches of Silkwood spider silk.
488.objectives: Bring 3 Shadecat Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 Silkwood Spider Silk to Zann Rothoof outside Fernwatch.

489.title: Seek Redemption!
489.details: The fel cones that grow in the woods round Fernwatch are what I need now. Bring me three.
489.objectives: Bring 3 Fel Cones to Zann Rothoof outside Fernwatch.

997.title: Denalor's Earth
997.details:
Denalor studies the barklings by Lake Aleth, east of Fernwatch. He asked for this rare earth.

Take it to him.
997.objectives: Take the Rare Earth to Denalor at Lake Aleth.
997.completion: The earth! At last. Now my work can go on.

918.title: Barkling Seeds
918.details:
The barklings round the lake have gone wild. Their seeds hold the secret of it.

Bring me eight.
918.objectives: Bring 8 Barkling Seeds to Denalor at Lake Aleth.
918.completion: These seeds are tainted. As I feared.

919.title: Barkling Sprouts
919.details: The barklings' sprouts grow along the lake shore. Gather twelve before they take root.
919.objectives: Bring 12 Barkling Sprouts to Denalor at Lake Aleth.
919.completion: Good. I will plant them in clean earth.

475.title: A Troubling Breeze
475.details:
There's trouble in Starbreeze, the village in the north-east. We've heard nothing from them in days.

Go there and speak with Gaeron Talvesh.
475.objectives: Speak with Gaeron Talvesh at Starbreeze.
475.completion: You've come from Fernwatch? Then you've seen what's become of us.

476.title: Twistbark Corruption
476.details:
The Twistbark bearfolk overran the village. They were our friends once; now they're mad with rage.

Tell Athran Bearcloak in Fernwatch. He'll know what to do.
476.objectives: Return to Athran Bearcloak in Fernwatch.
476.completion: The Twistbark? Corrupted? Then the old fear has come true.

483.title: The Relics of Wakening
483.details:
Long ago the druids hid four relics in the Thornbarrow Den, west of Fernwatch. The Twistbark hold it now.

Recover the relics. With them we may yet wake the bearfolk from their madness.
483.objectives: Retrieve the four Relics of Wakening from the Thornbarrow Den and bring them to Athran Bearcloak.
483.progress: The relics are in the den.
483.completion: All four. With these we can begin.

486.title: Borrak the Mauler
486.details:
The relics tell me who is behind it: Borrak the Mauler, chief of the Twistbark, in their hold in the south.

Kill him, and their madness may break.
486.objectives: Kill Borrak the Mauler at Twistbark Hold, then return to Athran Bearcloak.
486.completion: He's dead? Then the bearfolk may yet be saved.

2438.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher
2438.details: My emerald dreamcatcher, I've lost it! It must be somewhere in my bower. I'd look myself, but my eyes aren't what they were.
2438.objectives: Find the Emerald Dreamcatcher in Tallon Swiftroot's bower.

487.title: The Road to Silverbough
487.details:
The Twistbark ambushers lie in wait along the road to Silverbough, attacking travellers.

Kill six.
487.objectives: Kill 6 Twistbark Ambushers on the road to Silverbough, then return to Sentinel Amaris Nightstep.
487.completion: The road is clear, for now. Thank you.

932.title: Twisted Hatred
932.details:
Lord Malvenn, a twisted thing of shadow, lairs in the Gloamrock north-east of Fernwatch. He torments the sprites there.

Kill him and bring me his head.
932.objectives: Kill Lord Malvenn in the Gloamrock and bring his head to Tallon Swiftroot in Fernwatch.
932.completion: His head. The sprites will rest easier.

2541.title: The Sleeping Druid
2541.details:
I am Orvel Wildclaw. My spirit is trapped here; my body was taken by the Twistbark shamans.

Bring me one of their voodoo charms.
2541.objectives: Bring a Shaman Voodoo Charm to Orvel Wildclaw at the Thornbarrow Den.
2541.completion: Yes. With this I may find my way back.

937.title: The Enchanted Glade
937.details:
The Crimsonwing harpies have taken the Seers' Glade, a holy place.

Bring me six of their belts.
937.objectives: Bring 6 Crimsonwing Belts to Sentinel Arwyn Cloudsong at the Seers' Glade.
937.completion: The glade is cleansed. Thank you.
